title: Suspected spook at the hotel during the DC hearings

tellings.quote: Amomar and I were at the DC hearings, you know, a few weeks ago and this just straight up spook came up to us

plain: Michels says that while he and the YouTuber Chris Ramsay were in Washington for the congressional hearings on UFOs, "a few weeks ago," a man he calls "just straight up spook," meaning an intelligence agent, walked up to them. He tells it to the writer Whitley Strieber, as something that happened to him. If true, intelligence people were keeping an eye on those who came to follow the hearings.
